about: Design-preview fixtures for the XS canvas. Illustrative scenarios, not canonical product records and not a service contract. The React app keeps its own shared world; reproduce the layouts, never these facts.

scenarios.basis: Same date as the approved V3 SA-01 (Fri 23 Oct 2026). Godavari access active since 8 Oct 2026 (B7-04 ACC-0107).

scenarios.sign_in_rule: Known sample e-mail (trimmed, case-insensitive) + any non-empty password signs in; anything else reads “The e-mail or password isn’t right”. Mirrors the Phase-7 stand-in. Real authentication is not implemented.
scenarios.rail_counts: Only Super Admin › Requests shows a count (3 requests under review), matching the approved V3 SA-01 seed for this date. Other role counts belong to their workstreams and are omitted.

scenarios.not_shown: The Super Admin pause and restore actions themselves (SA workstream, SA-07). No pause reason is shown to institution people: whether to show one is open (v46 board 08); the reason stays in the Super Admin history (v46 B7-04).

conflicts_recorded_not_resolved: SUP-0198 is listed in Rahul’s My reports on v46 board 05 and is a Faculty report on v46 board 07. This package follows board 07 (the Help board) and gives it to Dr S. Ranganathan.
SUP-0213 names two different reports in v46 (3 Oct 2026 and 20 Sep 2027, already flagged in the V3 handoff). This package uses the 3 Oct 2026 report.
The V3 IA-01 seed is dated Wed 22 Sep 2027; this package's world is Fri 23 Oct 2026 (the SA-01 date). Neither scenario is changed to match the other.
